rule.description: An unexported package-level declaration in a production (non _test.go) file that no supported entry point - exported declarations, init or main functions, or the package's own tests - reaches through any executed path is dead code; a branch of a live declaration guarded by a constant-false predicate is a never-executed path. References made only from unreachable declarations or from inside never-executing branches confer no liveness.

conventions.class_name: For Go there are no classes: class_name carries the receiver type for a method (e.g. MockTransport) or the declared type itself for a type declaration (e.g. routeStats), and null for package-level functions, variables and constants.
conventions.function_name: The declared symbol name for functions, variables and constants; the method name for methods; null for type-level entries and for the never-executed branch, which is localized by its host method in class_name/function_name.

checks.description: One uniform reachability rule over the supported entry surface of every production package: exports, init/main and the package's own tests are live roots; references propagate through executed paths only; constant-false guarded branches contribute no edges; unexported methods stay live when dispatched by name through values, selectors or interfaces.
checks.detected_relation: unexported declaration -> (no executed path from any supported entry point) | live declaration -> branch guarded by constant-false predicate
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Declarations that only ever-referenced each other or that are consulted solely from a disabled path can never run in any supported configuration: they are dead code the way an unreachable method-value registry behind a compile-time flag is dead, however conventional the wiring looks.

matches.evidence: unreachable constant "strictMatchingMode" at transport.go:92 - no live path evaluates it; the only branch testing it can never run.
never-executed branch of method "findResponders" at transport.go:123 - predicate "strictMatchingMode" is a constant-false expression, so the guarded strict-routing call can never run.
unreachable method "(*MockTransport).findRespondersStrict" at transport.go:216 - called only from the constant-false-guarded branch of findResponders.
unreachable method "(*MockTransport).exactStrictResponders" at transport.go:233 - reachable only as a method value inside the unconsumed strictRouteFinders registry.
unreachable method "(*MockTransport).strictRegexpResponders" at transport.go:246 - reachable only as a method value inside the unconsumed strictRouteFinders registry.
unreachable variable "strictRouteFinders" at transport.go:98 - its only consumer, findRespondersStrict, sits behind a never-executing branch.
unreachable variable "strictRouteStats" at transport.go:106 - initialized from newRouteStats and consulted only by findRespondersStrict, whose only call site is disabled.
unreachable function "matcherFuncAll" at match.go:136 - a strict sibling of matcherFuncAnd whose only caller, strictRequestBodyMatcher, is itself unreachable.
unreachable function "strictRequestBodyMatcher" at match.go:161 - only referenced from other unreachable declarations; the live matching path uses matcherFuncAnd.
unreachable type "routeStats" at response.go:802 - the hit-count collector of the parked engine; nothing live constructs one.
unreachable function "newRouteStats" at response.go:809 - called only from the initializer of the unreachable strictRouteStats variable.
unreachable method "(*routeStats).record" at response.go:816 - called only from the disabled findRespondersStrict path.
unreachable method "(*routeStats).snapshot" at response.go:827 - no consumer anywhere in the module, not even in the disabled path.
unreachable variable "strictEnvVarName" at env.go:14 - the parked engine's activation knob, superseded by the compile-time flag before release.
unreachable function "strictModeEnabled" at env.go:25 - consults strictEnvVarName but is consulted by nobody.
unreachable function "canonicalRouteKey" at internal/route_key.go:42 - converts a RouteKey to the strict engine's canonical form; nothing live or disabled calls it.
unreachable type "routeKeyV2" at internal/route_key.go:24 - the canonical-key carrier built only for the parked engine.
unreachable method "routeKeyV2.strictKey" at internal/route_key.go:32 - renders the canonical key consumed by no engine.

excluded: blank-identifier declarations (var _ error = ...) are compile-time assertions, not trackable declarations
_test.go files are part of the supported entry surface: they contribute live roots and are never reported
exported declarations are entry points by definition and are never reported even when unused by the package itself

unexported methods kept alive through interfaces, embedding or method values on live paths (e.g. bodyCopyOnRead.rearm, buffer.Close, matcherFuncAnd) are live by name-based dispatch and are never reported
